description:
Published human signed reviews of one paper: reviewer identity, axis
    deltas against the machine review, claim verdicts, defects, predictions,
    and who paid. Call this when the user asks what human experts said about
    a paper, on top of the machine review.

arxiv_id.description: Any form the user gave: bare arXiv id (2401.00001), arXiv abs/pdf URL, DOI or doi.org URL, or Pith Number.
